observations: Photo 0: white chest freezer exterior, scratched and dirty, thermostat dial visible bottom right, no readable brand plate.
Photo 1: interior copper evaporator tubing along the walls, no markings or capacity visible.
Photo 2: lid open showing empty interior, light wear, no brand or model visible.

claims.evidence: compressor not shown or testable from photos

risks.risk: Compressor does not start or pump refrigerant, so the freezer does not cool
risks.proof: video of compressor running and cabinet reaching freezing temperature
sustained cooling demonstration or technician pressure test

risks.risk: Power cord, plug, or thermostat failure
risks.proof: close-up of plug and cord plus power-on demonstration

proof_requests: Video showing the compressor starting and the freezer cooling
Photo of the compressor and any rating plate
Close-up of the power cord and plug
response.reason: The photos clearly show a used chest freezer; the compressor claim cannot be verified remotely, so it is priced at its worst case as non-working.
